stem_book: A dithermic container (containing an ideal gas) fitted with a piston at equilibrium (without any stopper) has initial volume 600 litre. The external pressure is suddenly reduced to 1 bar and the piston is allowed to move upward isothermally; in this process the system absorbs 600 kJ of heat. A student calculated ΔS_sys = 2 kJ/K (simply as q/T) and was awarded zero marks. Find the correct ΔS_sys (in kJ/K). [ln 11 = 2.4; 1 bar·L = 100 J] Fill the answer excluding decimal places (e.g. 6.02 → 6).
reason: Long story condensed; made explicit that the student's 2 kJ/K was q/T (fixes T = 300 K) and added 1 bar·L = 100 J.
